beats.say: Beyonce's 2003 debut album sold 317,000 copies in week one.
That is about 317,000 people buying a CD in seven days, a huge number for 2003.
The album, Dangerously in Love, debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 chart.
It featured Crazy in Love, which stayed at number one for eight weeks straight.
Today, the album has sold more than 11 million copies worldwide.

facts: Beyonce released her debut solo album Dangerously in Love in 2003.
Dangerously in Love debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 selling 317000 copies in its first week.
Crazy in Love topped the chart for eight consecutive weeks.
Dangerously in Love has sold more than 11 million copies globally.
